reasoning_content: The tarball is only 32MB? A normal Node.js tarball should be around 50MB. Hmm, let me check. Actually, Node 24 tarballs are around 30–40MB, so it might be fine. Let me verify the checksum and extract it.

action.command: cd /tmp && curl -sSL --max-time 30 -o SHASUMS256.txt https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.22.0/SHASUMS256.txt && grep "node-v24.22.0-linux-x64.tar.xz" SHASUMS256.txt | awk '{print $1}' > expected.txt && sha256sum node.tar.xz | awk '{print $1}' > actual.txt && cat expected.txt actual.txt && diff <(cat expected.txt) <(cat actual.txt) && echo CHECKSUM_OK
